title: InteractionAccessPurpose
description: Why content is read or exported (PRP-99). A fragment (no schema_version) embedded by access requests and InteractionExportManifest. A code plus an optional case reference, never prose (audit content_guard forbids it).

purpose_code.description: Purpose of the access; open-ended: readers must tolerate unknown values.

case_ref.description: Case record id (admin record_id). Null when none.
